error[ZC-E0811]: a certificate is expired or not yet valid
  cause  node2's certificate has expired: valid 2026-11-05T00:00:00Z to
         2026-11-06T00:00:00Z, now 2026-11-06T02:00:00Z (allowing 60 s of skew)
  fix    check the clocks on both sides, then ask for a new certificate   timedatectl
  more   zcube explain E0811 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0811.html
